test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2021: Official Paper (Held On : 24 May 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the denotation of the highlighted word.**

The __**guile**__ of the businessman is well known to his contemporaries.
solution:
The correct answer is **'Slyness'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Guile **is a **noun **that means sly or cunning intelligence.
 
• Let us look into the **meaning **of the given** options** - 
 
 
• **Courage - **the ability to do something that frightens one; bravery.
 
• **Shyness - **the quality or state of being shy.
 
• **Gentleness - **the quality of being kind, tender, or mild-mannered.
 
• **Slyness - **behaviour that is clever in order to deceive people and get what you want
 
 
 
• From the above meanings it is clear that **slyness **is the correct denotation of the highlighted word.
 
• Hence, **option 4 **is the correct answer. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The definition of **denotation **refers to the direct or dictionary meaning of a word, in contrast to its figurative or associated meanings (connotations).
 
• For example, the **denotation **of word *red *is just *colour red* but its **connotation **is *danger or blood.*
